result.brief: 提出融合机器人-地形接触动力学的物理一致世界模型 DR-WM，用仿真轨迹引导视频世界模型训练并迭代更新地形，用于四足机器人动作后果预测与动作选择。
result.reason: Builds a physically grounded video world model with terrain contact priors for quadruped action-consequence prediction, an embodied world-model application rather than a representation contribution.
